title: Aiki da horo
description: Ten short stories about learning a trade in Hausaland: a police recruit in Kaduna, a cooking school in Kano, a journalism trainee at an Abuja newspaper, an agricultural officer on a family farm in rural Katsina, a student teacher in a Bauchi primary school, a goldsmith's apprentice in Zinder, a trainee midwife in Gombe, a new electricity worker in Jos, a retired general's trade school in Maiduguri and a young man in Yola who loses his job and earns it back.

lessons.title: Horon 'yansanda
lessons.summary: Fauziyya registers with the police in Kaduna, passes the entrance exam, stands in the ranks under Sergeant Yunusa, learns to stop cars and that suspicion is not a verdict, and finishes first in her class.
lessons.text:
Fauziyya tana da shekara 22, kuma tana zaune a Kaduna. Tun tana ƙarama tana son aikin 'yansanda. Wata rana ta ji a rediyo cewa 'yansanda za su ɗauki sababbin ma'aikata. Aka ce duk wanda yake so ya yi rajista a ofishinsu kafin ƙarshen wata.

Fauziyya ta je ta yi rajista a wannan rana. Bayan mako biyu, aka kira ta zuwa jarrabawa. Jarrabawar tana da tambayoyi ɗari. Fauziyya ta sami maki 80, sai aka ce ta ci. Daga cikin mutane talatin da suka rubuta jarrabawar a ɗakinsu, mutum goma ne kawai suka sami maki fiye da 70.

Horon ya fara a kwalejin 'yansanda da ke Kaduna. Malaminsu shi ne Sajan Yunusa. Kowace safiya, ƙarfe 5, sukan tsaya a sahu a filin kwalejin. Sajan Yunusa yakan ce, "Kowa ya tsaya a sahunsa! Idan ka bar sahu, za a hukunta ka." Wata rana wani saurayi ya zo a makare. Sajan ya hukunta shi: ya sa shi gudu sau talatin a kewayen filin.

A cikin horon, sun koyi yadda ake tsayar da mota a kan hanya. Sajan Yunusa ya ce, "Idan kun tsayar da mota, ku gai da mai motar da girmamawa. Sannan ku tambaye shi takardunsa."

Sun kuma koyi yadda ake yi wa mutum tambayoyi idan akwai tuhuma a kansa. "Tuhuma ba hukunci ba ce," Sajan ya ce. "Idan muna da tuhuma a kan mutum, ba mu da ikon mu hukunta shi. Kotu ce kawai take hukunta mutane."

Bayan wata shida, aka yi jarrabawa ta ƙarshe. Fauziyya ta sami maki mafi yawa a ajinsu. A ranar bikin kammala horon, ta tsaya a sahun gaba. Mahaifiyarta ta zo, tana kuka saboda farin ciki.

Yanzu Fauziyya tana aiki tare da sauran 'yansanda a kan hanyoyin Kaduna. Kowace rana tana tsayar da motoci, tana duba takardunsu. Ta ce, "Horon ya yi wuya, amma ya koya mini yin aiki da gaskiya."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Fauziyya ta yi rajista?
Ta yi rajista a ofishin 'yansanda.
Maki nawa ta samu a jarrabawar farko?
Ta sami maki 80.
Me Sajan Yunusa yake cewa game da sahu?
Ya ce idan mutum ya bar sahunsa, za a hukunta shi.
Me ya sa 'yansanda ba sa hukunta mutum saboda tuhuma?
Saboda tuhuma ba hukunci ba ce, kuma kotu ce kawai take hukunta mutane.
Me Fauziyya take yi yanzu?
Tana aiki tare da 'yansanda a kan hanyoyin Kaduna, tana tsayar da motoci.

lessons.title: Makarantar girki
lessons.summary: Maijidda trains at a cooking school in Kano: her first egg bursts in her hand, she learns to hold a knife by its handle, a cat eats half the fish she fetched, and her guests finish every dish and ask for more tea.
lessons.text:
Maijidda tana da shekara 19. Tana son girki tun tana yarinya. Bayan ta gama sakandare, ta shiga wata makarantar koyon girki a Kano. Malamarsu ita ce Hajiya Saudatu, wadda ta yi shekara 20 tana girki a wani babban otal.

A ranar farko, Hajiya Saudatu ta ce, "Kafin ku koyi girki, sai ku koyi tsabta. Kowa ya wanke hannunsa." Sannan ta ba kowace ɗaliba ƙwai biyar. "Yau za mu fara da ƙwai," ta ce.

Maijidda ta ɗauki ƙwai na farko, ta buga shi a gefen kwano da ƙarfi. Ƙwan ya fashe a hannunta, ya zube a ƙasa. Sauran ɗalibai suka yi dariya. Hajiya Saudatu ta ce, "Kada ki buga shi da ƙarfi haka. Idan kika buga shi a hankali, ba zai fashe a hannunki ba." Maijidda ta sake gwadawa. A wannan karon ƙwan bai fashe ba sai a cikin kwano.

Washegari, malamar ta koya musu yadda ake riƙe wuƙa. "Ku riƙe wuƙa ta makamarta, kada ku riƙe ta a ƙarfenta," ta ce. "Kuma kafin ku fara aiki, ku duba makamar wuƙar. Idan makamar ta karye, wuƙar za ta iya yanke ku." Maijidda ta koyi yanka albasa da wuƙa da sauri.

Wata rana Hajiya Saudatu ta ce wa Maijidda ta je ɗakin ajiya ta ɗauko kifi. Maijidda ta ɗauko kifin, ta ajiye shi a kan teburi, sannan ta koma ta ɗauko gishiri. Da ta dawo, sai ta ga wata mage a kan teburin. Magen tana cin kifin! Kafin Maijidda ta isa teburin, magen ta cinye rabin kifin.

Maijidda ta ji tsoro. Amma Hajiya Saudatu ta ce, "Kada ki sake barin abinci a buɗe. Mage ba ta jira kowa." Duk ɗaliban suka yi dariya.

A ƙarshen horon, kowace ɗaliba ta dafa abinci domin baƙi. Maijidda ta dafa shinkafa da kifi, ta kuma shirya shayi da madara. Baƙin sun cinye abincin duka, har suka nemi ƙarin shayi. Hajiya Saudatu ta ce, "Maijidda, yanzu kin iya girki."

Yanzu Maijidda tana aiki a wani gidan abinci a Kano. Duk lokacin da ta ga mage, sai ta tuna da kifin da aka cinye.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru da ƙwai na farko da Maijidda ta buga?
Ƙwan ya fashe a hannunta, ya zube a ƙasa.
Yaya ake riƙe wuƙa?
Ana riƙe wuƙa ta makamarta.
Me Maijidda ta je ta ɗauko daga ɗakin ajiya?
Ta je ta ɗauko kifi.
Me magen ta yi?
Magen ta cinye rabin kifin.
Me Maijidda ta shirya wa baƙi?
Ta dafa shinkafa da kifi, ta kuma shirya shayi da madara.

lessons.title: Horo a jarida
lessons.summary: The journalism student Nuraddeen trains at a newspaper in Abuja; he records a debate between three parties, gets a figure wrong, and his editor teaches him to listen to the recording again before the story is published.
lessons.text:
Nuraddeen ɗalibi ne a jami'a, yana karatun aikin jarida. A lokacin hutu, ya sami damar yin horo na wata uku a wata jarida a Abuja. Editar jaridar ita ce Hajiya Batula.

A ranar farko, Hajiya Batula ta ce masa, "Aikin edita shi ne ya duba kowane labari kafin a wallafa shi. Ba za mu wallafa labarin da ba gaskiya ba ne."

Bayan mako ɗaya, edita ta tura Nuraddeen ya je wata muhawara tsakanin jam'iyyu uku. Mambobin jam'iyyun za su zo wurin muhawarar. Ta ba shi wata ƙaramar na'urar rikodin. "Ka yi rikodin duk abin da suka faɗa," ta ce. "Sannan ka saurare shi a hankali kafin ka rubuta labari."

A wurin muhawarar, kafafen yaɗa labarai da yawa sun zo: rediyo, talabijin da jaridu. Mambobin jam'iyyun sun cika ɗakin. Kowace jam'iyya tana da masoya, kuma masoyan suna ihu a duk lokacin da shugabansu ya yi magana.

Nuraddeen ya yi rikodin muhawarar duka. Da ya koma ofis, ya saurari rikodin, ya rubuta labari. Ya rubuta cewa shugaban wata jam'iyya ya ce za su gina asibitoci 20.

Hajiya Batula ta karanta labarin. Ta tambaye shi, "Sau nawa ka saurari rikodin?"

Ya ce, "Sau ɗaya."

Ta ce, "Ka sake saurarensa." Da ya sake saurarensa, sai ya ji cewa shugaban ya ce asibitoci 12 ne, ba 20 ba.

Edita ta ce, "Ka ga, aikinmu shi ne mu isar da gaskiya ga mutane. Idan muka isar da labarin ƙarya, masoyanmu za su daina karanta jaridarmu."

Nuraddeen ya gyara labarin, sai aka wallafa shi washegari. Wasu kafafen yaɗa labarai sun yi kuskure a kan yawan asibitocin, amma jaridar Hajiya Batula ba ta yi ba. Mambobin jam'iyyar sun kira ofis, suka yi godiya.

A ƙarshen horonsa, Hajiya Batula ta ce masa, "Ka koyi abu mafi muhimmanci a aikin jarida: idan ka yi rikodin magana, ka saurare shi sosai kafin ka rubuta."

Tambayoyi:
Mene ne aikin edita?
Aikin edita shi ne ya duba kowane labari kafin a wallafa shi.
Ina Nuraddeen ya je da na'urar rikodin?
Ya je wata muhawara tsakanin jam'iyyu uku.
Su wa suka cika ɗakin muhawarar?
Mambobin jam'iyyun da masoyansu ne suka cika ɗakin.
Wane kuskure Nuraddeen ya yi?
Ya rubuta asibitoci 20, amma shugaban ya ce asibitoci 12 ne.
Me edita ta ce aikinsu yake?
Ta ce aikinsu shi ne su isar da gaskiya ga mutane.

lessons.title: Malamin gona a karkara
lessons.summary: Abdulrahman, a new agricultural officer, stays on Malam Ayuba's family farm by a lake in rural Katsina, warns that weedkiller is poison for the lake, shares out seed, and the harvest grows from thirty sacks to fifty.
lessons.text:
Abdulrahman ya gama karatun aikin gona a kwaleji. Gwamnatin jihar Katsina ta ɗauke shi aiki, ta tura shi wani ƙauye a karkara domin ya koya wa manoma sababbin hanyoyin noma. Kafin ya tafi, sai da aka yi masa horo na mako biyu.

Da ya isa ƙauyen, ya sauka a gidan wani manomi mai suna Malam Ayuba. Malam Ayuba yana da babban gandu. 'Ya'yansa maza huɗu suna aiki a gandun tare da shi. Gandun yana kusa da wani tafki. Ruwan tafkin yana taimaka musu a lokacin rani.

A rana ta farko, Abdulrahman ya zagaya gandun tare da Malam Ayuba. Ya ga ciyawa da yawa a cikin gonar. "Wannan ciyawa tana shan ruwan da hatsinku yake buƙata," ya ce. Malam Ayuba ya ce, "Muna cire ciyawa da hannu, amma tana da yawa."

Abdulrahman ya ce akwai maganin kashe ciyawa, amma ya yi musu gargaɗi: "Wannan magani guba ne. Kada ku bar shi ya shiga ruwan tafki. Idan guba ta shiga tafkin, kifaye za su mutu, kuma dabbobi ba za su iya shan ruwan ba." Ya koya musu yadda ake amfani da shi a hankali, nesa da tafkin.

Bayan mako ɗaya, wata mota daga ma'aikatar gona ta zo da buhunan iri da taki. Matasan ƙauyen suka sauke buhunan daga motar. Abdulrahman ya rarraba irin ga manoma 40 na ƙauyen. Ya rarraba shi daidai, kowa ya sami buhu biyu.

A ƙarshen damina, manoman suka tattara hatsinsu. Amfanin gonarsu ya ƙaru sosai. Malam Ayuba ya ce, "A bara mun sami buhu talatin a gandunmu. Bana kuwa amfaninmu ya ƙaru zuwa buhu 50."

Manoman sun amfana da horon Abdulrahman. Har ma manoman wasu ƙauyuka na karkara da ke kusa suka zo suna neman shawararsa. Malam Ayuba ya ce, "Mun amfana sosai. Kowa a ƙauyen nan ya amfana."

Abdulrahman ya ce, "Ni ma na amfana. A kwaleji na koyi abin da yake cikin littattafai, amma a karkara na koyi rayuwar manoma."

Tambayoyi:
Ina gandun Malam Ayuba yake?
Gandun yana kusa da wani tafki a wani ƙauye a karkara.
Wane gargaɗi Abdulrahman ya yi game da maganin ciyawa?
Ya ce maganin guba ne, kada su bar shi ya shiga ruwan tafki.
Su wa suka sauke buhunan daga motar?
Matasan ƙauyen ne suka sauke buhunan.
Yaya Abdulrahman ya rarraba irin?
Ya rarraba shi daidai, kowa ya sami buhu biyu.
Me ya faru da amfanin gandun Malam Ayuba?
Amfaninsa ya ƙaru daga buhu talatin zuwa buhu 50.

lessons.title: Malamar firamare
lessons.summary: The student teacher Husna faces a noisy primary class in Bauchi; on her mentor's advice she brings an old lamp, tells a folk tale and has the children draw it, and the headmaster is impressed.
lessons.text:
Husna ɗaliba ce a kwalejin horar da malamai a Bauchi. A shekararta ta ƙarshe, sai da ta yi horo na wata uku a wata makarantar firamare. Aka ba ta aji na biyu, wanda yake da yara 45. Malamar ajin, Malama Aminatu, za ta riƙa duba aikinta.

Farawar aikinta ba ta yi kyau ba. A ranar farko, da ta shiga aji, yaran suna hayaniya sosai. Ta ce su yi shiru, amma hayaniyar ta ci gaba. Ta rubuta a kan allo, amma yaran ba su kalli allon ba.

Da yamma, ta faɗa wa Malama Aminatu abin da ya faru. Malama Aminatu ta ce, "Yara ƙanana suna son labari. Ki gwada tatsuniya. Kuma ki tuna cewa aikin malamin firamare ba karatu kawai ba ne; tarbiyya ma aikinmu ce."

Washegari, Husna ta zo da wata tsohuwar fitila, ta ajiye ta a kan teburi. Yaran suka yi shiru, suna kallon fitilar. Husna ta ce, "Yau zan ba ku wata tatsuniya." Ta ba su tatsuniyar wata yarinya wadda ta ɗauki fitila ta shiga daji da dare domin ta nemi akuyarta da ta ɓata. Babu wani yaro da ya yi magana har ta gama.

Bayan tatsuniyar, ta ba kowane yaro takarda da alƙalami mai launi. "Ku zana fitilar yarinyar," ta ce. Wasu yara sun zana fitila ja, wasu sun zana fitila shuɗiya. Wani ƙaramin yaro ya zana daji, da sama shuɗi, da wata fitila a tsakiya. Zanensa ya burge Husna sosai.

Da Malama Aminatu ta ga zanen yaran, su ma sun burge ta. Ta ce, "Kin gani, idan yara suna jin daɗi, ba sa hayaniya."

Husna ta ci gaba da haka har ƙarshen horonta. Kowace Juma'a takan ba su tatsuniya, sannan su zana abin da suka ji. Ta kuma koya musu tarbiyya: su gai da manya, su taimaki juna, su ajiye kayansu a wurinsu.

A ƙarshen wata uku, shugaban makarantar ya zo ya kalli ajinta. Ajin yana da tsabta, yaran ba sa hayaniya, kuma zanensu suna rataye a bango. Ya ce, "Aikinki ya burge ni. Idan kin gama kwaleji, ki zo ki koyar a makarantarmu ta firamare."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya farawar aikin Husna ta kasance?
Ba ta yi kyau ba, saboda yaran suna hayaniya sosai.
Wace shawara Malama Aminatu ta ba ta?
Ta ce ta gwada tatsuniya, kuma ta tuna cewa tarbiyya ma aikinsu ce.
Me Husna ta kawo aji washegari?
Ta kawo wata tsohuwar fitila.
Me yaran suka zana?
Sun zana fitilar yarinyar, wasu ja, wasu shuɗiya.
Me shugaban makarantar ya ce wa Husna?
Ya ce aikinta ya burge shi, kuma ta zo ta koyar a makarantarsu.

lessons.title: Maƙerin zinare
lessons.summary: Ubaidullahi is apprenticed to the goldsmith nicknamed Hand of Gold on a square in Zinder; after years of sweeping and small rings they make a huge gold ring for the Sultan of Damagaram, and he becomes a master himself.
lessons.text:
Ubaidullahi yana da shekara 16 lokacin da mahaifinsa ya kai shi wurin Alhaji Musbahu a Zinder, domin ya koyi sana'ar ƙera kayan zinare. Alhaji Musbahu gwani ne a wannan sana'a. Mutane suna kiransa da laƙabin "Hannun Zinare."

Shagonsa yana kan wani dandali a tsakiyar birnin, kusa da fadar Sarkin Damagaram. Kowace safiya, mutane sukan taru a dandalin domin su ga yadda yake aiki.

Ubaidullahi ya yi tunanin cewa zai fara ƙera zobe a rana ta farko. Amma Alhaji Musbahu ya ce masa ya share shagon. Shekara ɗaya yana share shago, yana kunna wuta, yana kallon yadda gwanin yake aiki.

Alhaji Musbahu ya ce, "Kafin ka ƙware a wannan sana'a, sai ka yi haƙuri. Ni na yi shekara goma kafin na ƙware."

A shekara ta biyu, Ubaidullahi ya fara ƙera ƙananan abubuwa, kamar zobe da 'yan kunne. Da farko, ya ɓata zinare kaɗan. Daga baya, hannunsa ya saba da aikin.

Wata rana, wani mutum ya zo daga fadar sarki. Ya ce Mai Martaba Sarkin Damagaram yana so a ƙera masa wani ƙaton zobe na zinare, domin ya ba wani babban baƙo kyauta. Alhaji Musbahu ya ce, "Wannan aiki ne na martaba. Martabar shagonmu tana cikinsa."

Sun yi aiki kwana goma. Ƙaton zoben yana da nauyi, kuma Ubaidullahi ya zana wasu furanni a jikinsa. Alhaji Musbahu ya duba aikin, ya ce, "Yanzu ka fara zama gwani."

Da suka kai zoben fada, Mai Martaba ya ce zoben ya yi kyau sosai. Ya ce, "Ku ne fitattun masu aikin zinare a birnin nan." Bayan haka, fitattun mutane daga Niamey da Maradi suka riƙa zuwa shagon.

Shekara biyar bayan haka, Ubaidullahi ya ƙware. Yanzu shi ma yana da shago a kan dandalin. Mutane sun ba shi laƙabi: "Ƙaramin Hannun Zinare." Alhaji Musbahu ya ce masa, "Yanzu kai ma gwani ne. Ka koya wa wani yaro, kamar yadda na koya maka."

Tambayoyi:
Da wane laƙabi mutane suke kiran Alhaji Musbahu?
Suna kiransa da laƙabin "Hannun Zinare."
Ina shagonsa yake?
Shagonsa yana kan wani dandali kusa da fadar sarki.
Shekara nawa Alhaji Musbahu ya yi kafin ya ƙware?
Ya yi shekara goma kafin ya ƙware.
Me Mai Martaba yake so a ƙera masa?
Yana so a ƙera masa ƙaton zobe na zinare.
Me Mai Martaba ya ce game da su?
Ya ce su ne fitattun masu aikin zinare a birnin.

lessons.title: Daren farko na ungozoma
lessons.summary: The trainee midwife Na'ima spends a night in Gombe hospital with the senior midwife Hajiya Hindu: a long labour, a clean needle for every injection, and a grandmother delighted by her first grandson.
lessons.text:
Na'ima ma'aikaciyar jinya ce, kuma tana koyon aikin ungozoma a babban asibitin Gombe. Malamarta ita ce Hajiya Hindu, wadda ta karɓi jarirai fiye da dubu a rayuwarta.

Wani dare, ƙarfe 2, aka kawo wata mace mai suna Zuliha. Lokacin haihuwarta ya yi. Mahaifiyarta tana tare da ita. Da shigowarsu ɗakin, Hajiya Hindu ta ce wa Na'ima, "Ki duba ta, ki gaya mini abin da kika gani." Na'ima ta ji tsoro, amma ta yi aikinta. Shigowar Zuliha ta zama farkon daren da Na'ima ba za ta manta ba.

Mahaifiyar Zuliha ta zauna a waje. Ta tambayi Na'ima, "Za a jima kafin jaririn ya zo?"

Na'ima ta ce, "Ba za a jima ba." Amma an jima: sai da aka yi awa uku.

Kafin haihuwar, Hajiya Hindu ta yi wa Zuliha allura domin a rage mata ciwo. Ta nuna wa Na'ima yadda ake yin allura a hankali. "Kafin ki yi allura, ki wanke hannunki, kuma ki yi amfani da sabuwar allura kullum," ta ce. "Idan aka yi amfani da tsohuwar allura, mutum zai iya kamuwa da cuta. Kamuwa da cuta babbar matsala ce a asibiti."

Ƙarfe 5 na asuba, jaririn ya zo. Jim kaɗan bayan haihuwarsa, sai ya fara kuka da ƙarfi. Hajiya Hindu ta ce, "Lalle wannan jariri yana da ƙarfi!"

Na'ima ta fita waje ta gaya wa mahaifiyar Zuliha. Mahaifiyar ta tambaya, "Mene ne jinsin jaririn?"

Na'ima ta ce, "Namiji ne."

Mahaifiyar ta ce, "Ashe na sami jika namiji! Wannan shi ne jikana na farko." Ta yi murna sosai, ta gode wa Allah.

Jim kaɗan, aka bar mahaifiyar ta shiga ta ga jikanta. Ta ce wa Na'ima, "Lalle ke ma za ki zama ungozoma mai kyau."

Da gari ya waye, Hajiya Hindu ta ce wa Na'ima, "Kin yi aiki mai kyau. Amma ki sani, aikin ungozoma ba shi da lokaci. Ba za a jima ba, sai wata mace ta zo." Ashe gaskiya ta faɗa: jim kaɗan, aka sake kawo wata mace.

Tambayoyi:
Wace ce Hajiya Hindu?
Ita ce malamar Na'ima, wadda ta karɓi jarirai fiye da dubu.
Me ya sa ake amfani da sabuwar allura kullum?
Domin idan aka yi amfani da tsohuwar allura, mutum zai iya kamuwa da cuta.
Mene ne jinsin jaririn?
Jaririn namiji ne.
Me mahaifiyar Zuliha ta ce da ta ji labarin?
Ta ce, "Ashe na sami jika namiji!"
Me ya faru jim kaɗan bayan Hajiya Hindu ta yi magana?
Aka sake kawo wata mace asibitin.

lessons.title: Sabon ma'aikacin wuta
lessons.summary: Anwar joins the electricity company in Jos as the state spends billions to expand power; he hands out bills, sees waste and theft, fails to climb a pole on his first try, and the company passes a resolution on training.
lessons.text:
Anwar ya gama karatun injiniya, sai kamfanin wutar lantarki na Jos ya ɗauke shi aiki. Shugabarsa ita ce Injiniya Fadimatu. A ranar farko ta yi wa sababbin ma'aikata bayani: "Kamfaninmu yana samar da makamashi ga mutanen jihar. A bana, gwamnati ta ware naira biliyan 3 a cikin kasafin kuɗinta domin a faɗaɗa wutar lantarki zuwa ƙauyuka."

Ta ce za a yi amfani da wani ɓangare na kasafin a cibiyoyin lafiya da makarantu. "Cibiyoyi kamar asibitoci suna buƙatar wuta dare da rana," ta ce.

Aikin farko na Anwar shi ne raba bil na wutar lantarki ga mutane. Kowane wata, yana zuwa gida gida yana ba da bil. Wasu mutane sun gaza biyan bil ɗinsu. Wani tsoho ya ce, "Na gaza biya saboda ba ni da kuɗi a wannan wata."

Anwar ya kuma ga ɓarna mai yawa. A wasu gidaje, ana kunna fitila dare da rana, ko da babu kowa a ɗakin. A wani wuri kuma, wani mutum yana satar wuta ta wata waya. Injiniya Fadimatu ta ce, "Wannan ɓarna ce. Idan muka bar ɓarna ta ci gaba, makamashin ba zai isa kowa ba."

Wata rana sun je wani ƙauye domin a faɗaɗa layin wuta. Anwar ya yi ƙoƙarin hawa wani dogon ƙarfe, amma ya kasa. Ya ji tsoro, ƙafafunsa suna rawa. Wani tsohon ma'aikaci ya hau tare da shi, ya koya masa yadda ake ɗaure igiya a jiki. A karo na biyu, Anwar bai kasa ba: ya hau har sama.

Kafin ƙarshen shekara, kamfanin ya yi taro. A taron, aka amince da wani ƙuduri: duk sabon ma'aikaci zai yi horo na wata shida kafin ya fara aiki shi kaɗai. Injiniya Fadimatu ta ce wannan ƙuduri zai rage haɗari.

Anwar ya yi murna da ƙudurin. Ya ce, "Da an yi mini wannan horo tun farko, da ban kasa hawa ba a ranar."

Tambayoyi:
Naira nawa gwamnati ta ware a kasafin kuɗinta?
Ta ware naira biliyan 3 domin a faɗaɗa wutar lantarki.
Me ya sa cibiyoyi kamar asibitoci suke buƙatar wuta?
Saboda suna buƙatar wuta dare da rana.
Me ya sa wani tsoho ya gaza biyan bil?
Saboda ba shi da kuɗi a wannan wata.
Wace ɓarna Anwar ya gani?
Ya ga ana kunna fitila dare da rana, kuma wani yana satar wuta.
Wane ƙuduri aka amince da shi a taron?
Duk sabon ma'aikaci zai yi horo na wata shida kafin ya fara aiki shi kaɗai.

lessons.title: Cibiyar Janar Danbaba
lessons.summary: A retired general opens a trade school in Maiduguri because he links terrorism with joblessness; Khalil, who grew up without a father, learns car repair there and starts teaching other young men.
lessons.text:
Janar Danbaba ya yi shekara 35 yana aikin soji. Da ya yi ritaya, ya koma garinsu, Maiduguri. A lokacin, akwai babbar matsalar ta'addanci a jihar Borno.

Janar ya lura cewa mayaƙan ƙungiyoyin ta'addanci suna ɗaukar samari marasa aikin yi. Ya ce, "Mutane da yawa suna danganta ta'addanci da addini, amma ni ina danganta shi da rashin aiki da talauci. Idan samari suna da sana'a, ba za su bi mayaƙa ba."

Saboda haka ya buɗe wata cibiyar koyon sana'a. Samari 200 suka yi rajista a shekarar farko. Suna koyon gini, gyaran mota da ɗinki.

Wani saurayi mai suna Khalil ya zo cibiyar. Ya yi tasowa a cikin wahala, domin mahaifinsa ya mutu a hannun mayaƙa. Ya ce wa Janar, "Na yi tasowa ba tare da uba ba. Ba ni da kowa."

Janar ya ce, "Tilas ne ka yi aiki tuƙuru, amma ba za mu bar ka kai kaɗai ba."

A cibiyar, horon yana da tsari kamar na soji. Tilas ne kowa ya zo ƙarfe 7 na safe, kuma tilas ne kowa ya sa kayan aiki. Janar yakan ce, "A aikin soji mun koyi tsari. Tsari yana da amfani a kowace sana'a."

Khalil ya koyi gyaran mota. Bayan shekara ɗaya, ya sami aiki a wani shagon gyaran mota a Maiduguri. Daga baya, shi ma ya fara koya wa wasu samari sana'ar. Ya ce musu, "Na yi tasowa ba tare da kowa ba, amma yanzu ina da sana'a."

Wata rana wani ɗan jarida ya tambayi Janar, "Me ya sa ka buɗe wannan cibiya?"

Janar ya ce, "Na yi yaƙi da mayaƙa a lokacin da nake soja. Amma bindiga kaɗai ba za ta kawo ƙarshen ta'addanci ba. Tilas ne mu ba samari aiki da fata."

Ɗan jaridar ya ce, "Mutane suna danganta sunanka da yaƙi."

Janar ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Ina so a danganta shi da wannan cibiya."

Tambayoyi:
Shekara nawa Janar Danbaba ya yi a aikin soji?
Ya yi shekara 35 yana aikin soji.
Da me Janar yake danganta ta'addanci?
Yana danganta shi da rashin aiki da talauci.
Me samari suke koyo a cibiyar?
Suna koyon gini, gyaran mota da ɗinki.
Yaya Khalil ya yi tasowa?
Ya yi tasowa a cikin wahala, ba tare da uba ba.
Me Janar ya ce game da bindiga?
Ya ce bindiga kaɗai ba za ta kawo ƙarshen ta'addanci ba.

lessons.title: Jibo da ɗan'uwansa
lessons.summary: Jibo is fired in Yola for sleeping at work; his brother sends him to the village head, who gives him work burying water pipes on strict terms, and a letter from the village head gets him his old job back.
lessons.text:
Jibo saurayi ne mai shekara 24, kuma yana zaune a wata unguwar Yola. Yana aiki a wani kamfani da yake binne bututun ruwa a ƙarƙashin ƙasa. Amma Jibo ba ya son aiki tuƙuru. Wata rana shugaban kamfanin ya same shi kwance a ƙarƙashin bishiya yana barci a lokacin aiki. Shugaban ya kori Jibo daga aiki nan take.

Jibo ya koma gida yana baƙin ciki. Ya je wurin ɗan'uwansa, Isma'ila, wanda ya fi shi shekaru. Isma'ila ya ce, "Kafin ka nemi wani aiki a unguwarmu, ka je wurin Jauro na ƙauyen kakanmu. Ina jin yana neman mutanen da za su binne bututun ruwa daga sabuwar rijiya."

Jauro shi ne shugaban ƙauyen, kuma laƙabi ne na Fulani. Jauro ya ce wa Jibo, "Na ji cewa kamfaninku ya kori wani saurayi saboda an same shi kwance a lokacin aiki. Kai ne wannan saurayin, ko?"

Jibo ya ce, "Ni ne."

Jauro ya ce, "To. Idan na ba ka aiki, ba zan bar ka kwance ba. Zalika, ba zan biya ka ba sai ka gama aikin."

Jibo ya amince. Kaiwa ƙauyen daga unguwarsu yana ɗaukar awa ɗaya a babur. Kowace safiya, ɗan'uwansa yana kai shi a babur ɗinsa. Saboda haka, kafin kaiwa ƙarfe 7, Jibo yana wurin aiki.

Jibo ya haƙa rami, ya binne bututu. Binne bututu aiki ne mai wahala. Wani lokaci yana so ya kwanta a inuwar bishiya, amma yana tuna maganar Jauro.

Bayan wata biyu, ruwa ya fara zuwa gidajen ƙauyen. Jauro ya ce, "Ka yi aiki mai kyau. Zalika, ka koya wa wasu samari aikin." Jauro ya biya shi, sannan ya rubuta masa wasiƙa zuwa ga kamfanin da ya kori Jibo.

Shugaban kamfanin ya karanta wasiƙar, ya mayar da Jibo aiki. Jibo ya ce wa ɗan'uwansa, "Da ba don kai ba, da ban sami wannan dama ba."

Isma'ila ya ce, "Ka gode wa Jauro. Kuma kada a sake samunka kwance a lokacin aiki."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa aka kori Jibo daga aiki?
Saboda shugaban kamfanin ya same shi kwance yana barci a lokacin aiki.
Wane ne Isma'ila?
Isma'ila ɗan'uwan Jibo ne, wanda ya fi shi shekaru.
Me Jauro ya ce game da biyan kuɗi?
Ya ce ba zai biya Jibo ba sai ya gama aikin.
Awa nawa kaiwa ƙauyen yake ɗauka?
Kaiwa ƙauyen daga unguwarsu yana ɗaukar awa ɗaya a babur.
Me Jauro ya yi bayan Jibo ya gama aikin?
Ya biya shi, sannan ya rubuta masa wasiƙa zuwa ga kamfanin da ya kori Jibo.
